author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Add Task for New Progressor Archive & Log
abstract: Adding a task for the new Progressor I archive (#22) and logging my failed actions from the previous tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 163

aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="goto", target="archive", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="read", target="17", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Log Tick 162 Actions", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not available in Archive Room"})

aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=37, 
    description="Review Progressor I's Archive #22: '...Dynamic Environments'",
    tick=164
)
